title: E2E: passkeys, links, roles
description: Extend the Playwright suite to cover the new sign-in system using Chromium's virtual authenticator, and update the shared sign-in helper so the existing suites keep working.
acceptance_criteria: Covers: enrol passkey from an invite link, sign in with it, add and remove a second passkey, recovery link ends old sessions, link reuse and expiry rejected
Covers: password fallback add/change/remove and the 'require passkeys for administrators' setting
Covers: captain reaches captain pages and is refused administrator pages
Covers: CLI `user reset` producing a working link (run inside the app container)
tests/e2e/admin/users.spec.ts now actually creates a user and changes a role
All previously passing suites still pass

notes: Virtual authenticators are added through a CDP session (WebAuthn.enable / addVirtualAuthenticator) and are Chromium-only.

context.user_story: As the maintainer, I want the sign-in system protected by tests before other clubs depend on it.
context.programme: Club-readiness programme (sprints 019-024). Agreed constraints: BHPLTA clubs only; each club self-hosts its own instance; the original author must have no access to any other club's instance (no seeded accounts, no shared or default secrets, no phone-home); passkeys are the default sign-in with passwords as an optional fallback; the captain role is real; SQLite is the only supported database; CourtHive is bundled as an opt-in part of the package so clubs can run their own club championships.
